property_summary: In any withdraw, if the outgoing external call reverts, the caller's balance must remain intact (C only zeroes after a successful send), whereas the mutant zeroes first and sends 0, so the call succeeds and the balance is lost.
change_summary: Move the balance-zeroing statement before the external call so a reentrant caller observes a zero balance, changing balances visible during nested calls (and enabling different observable outcomes on reentrancy).
